holdout.start_rule: First eligible JNU trading day strictly after 2026-08-31
holdout.rationale: Approximately six months of genuinely forward exact-product observations; fixed before any post-cutoff outcome inspection.
holdout.pending_behavior: If fewer than 126 eligible new trading days exist, report only available-day count and data-integrity status; do not compute or reveal QLIKE/MSE/bootstrap holdout performance.
holdout.leakage_rule: No date on or before 2026-08-31 may enter holdout.

frozen_models.challenger: HAR_RSV: logRV_t ~ 1 + logRSV+_{t-1} + logRSV-_{t-1} + weekly_logRV + monthly_logRV
frozen_models.coefficient_estimation: Fit each model once using all causally eligible exact-JNU Micro observations through 2026-08-31; freeze coefficients before scoring Stage8 holdout.
frozen_models.predictor_updates: Lagged realized RV/RSV observations from completed holdout days may enter future-day predictors causally; coefficients remain frozen.

pass_all: At least one of QLIKE or MSE 5-day block-bootstrap probabilities of positive improvement >= 0.95
Exactly 126 preregistered forward trading days are evaluated

interpretation.pass: STAGE8_FORWARD_HOLDOUT_PASS; proceed to Stage9 role-consistent validation review for volatility/risk-state use only.
interpretation.fail: STAGE8_FORWARD_HOLDOUT_FAIL_CURRENT_SPEC; HAR-RSV remains non-validated and may not be rescued by refitting windows/features/thresholds on this holdout.

forbidden: Inspect partial holdout performance before 126 days
Refit coefficients using holdout target outcomes
Change bootstrap block length, samples, seed, or 0.95 threshold
Select a favorable shorter/later holdout after outcome inspection
Add leverage, jumps, neural features, filters, or regimes to rescue a failure
Use a Stage8 risk-state PASS as directional alpha
next_action: Implement a fail-closed Stage8 runner/selftest that emits no performance metrics until 126 post-cutoff trading days are present.
